scope: Standalone S31 hart0 functional MMU/cache-bus gates; not a product runtime or flash boot implementation
sources: sources.json; ESP-IDF v6.1 fff9895c82d744c7237be8847347bdd1b07c6643 cache_reg.h, spi_mem_c/s_reg.h, ext_mem_defs.h, cache_ll.h, mmu_ll.h; pmu_reg.h identifies next fault

model.initialTable: All invalid; deliberate deterministic model input, not a claim about power-on MMU SRAM contents
limits: Functional coherent access without cache lines, timing, maintenance, encryption or cache-error IRQs
Only hart0 external instruction/data gates execute; ROM-cache aliases, second hart and DMA excluded
Flash/PSRAM bytes and capacities are explicit host inputs; 256/64 MiB ceilings are software allocation limits
Invalid/sensitive mappings and unavailable backing memory fault; mapped flash writes prohibited without SPI program engine
No product catalog changes or production S31 WASM export

fixture.execution: SRAM guest writes MMU ports, calls Flash-mapped worker, worker writes PSRAM and returns; guest changes mapping to an empty physical page then restores original data

negativeRuns.missing: PSRAM physical page1 with only8192bytes allocated

fixture.testCommand: S31_UART_ELF=<probe.elf> S31_UART_IRQ_ELF=<irq-probe.elf> S31_TRNG_ELF=<trng-probe.elf> S31_WDT_ELF=<wdt-probe.elf> S31_MMU_ELF=<mmu-probe.elf> S31_FLASH_WORKER_BIN=<flash-worker.bin> cargo test --release -p esp32s31 --test uart_fixture -- --include-ignored --nocapture (all paths absolute)

checks.sourceFixtures: 5 passed: UART/FPU, UART IRQ, TRNG gates, RTC WDT IRQ/reset, MMU flash/PSRAM plus negative runs
checks.wasm: 9 existing workloads pass, including P4 hello; production sections check passed
checks.browser: No UI changes or browser sessions

privacy: Curated hashes, outcomes and relative commands. Raw logs and personal paths omitted; no private firmware/captures retained.

performance.outputChecks: All UART SHA-256 and instruction/cycle/stat fields exact across both sides and all samples
performance.interpretation: Not an attributed speedup: existing production code is byte-identical to preceding stage; standalone new S31 code is not reached by these workloads.
